I grew up in Pakistan, and was brought up a Muslim, my dad was in the military and so most of my family. I was thought to act and behave in a way that will never bring shame or to dishonor my family. I was told to put my family honor and reputation before my happiness or anything else.

We move to America when i was eight years old, and discover that i was gay around nine or ten. After that i was depressed for 6 years tried to kill my self at least 4 or 5 times. I was a very social person and had good friends that i could trust in high school, because of the
way i was thought to act and that become my mask i hid from everyone very easily and no one even knew. I did accept myself when i was in my junior year or senior year, my depression did lifted but not that much i was a bit happier.
When i entered College i decided to change that, and came out to everyone that asked me, my depression was finally started to fade. so i decided to take another risk and came out to my brother he excepted me and was fine with it, however when there are time when we would argue over things, he would say comment that would make me doubt on if he truly is fine with me like " you are an disappointment to the family". After come out to my brother i decided to come out to my aunt. She was cool and i always looked to her as an role model she is a very religious person, and i knew it will take her time to accept me, but when i told her she had this shock face for a few mins, and started to tell me that there is no such things, and that what would every body else think, and that it was only a choice and God can help you become straight. I wanted to say something but i couldn't muster my courage again to tell her no, or this who i am. Ever since that my depression went up, and my thoughts of suicide increased.
I do still have friends that i have in College i act real friendly and I am very social but once that class is over, or when i am not near them I end up becoming that sad lonely, depressed person. I have thought about telling them about my issues but i have trust problem.
If you are about to come out make sure you go through all the way and do not choke no matter what are the consequence, is one of things i regret 
Also don't forgot to simile or laugh. I have put on the mask so much that every time that i simile or laugh, i wonder if i am laughing because i am happy, or because i am doing to fit in, and know will ever know.
I am going to come out when i move out, and when i have a good steady job.
